hypothesis: V75 improves means but degrades broad PDS: shrinking downstream responses while retaining fixed direct own knockdown changes response composition. Test convex mixtures of the COMPLETE V66 bulk profile and control (response fractions .75/.50), and direct-own-factor .30/.55 controls. No new cellular sampler. Partial-response mixture interpretation is a working biological hypothesis, not identified responder fractions.
representation: Build V66 closed profile with old own factor .1 exactly once. A mixture p=(1-gain)*control+gain*parent is closed and nonnegative before bounds, and jointly dilutes direct knockdown and downstream response. Encode FULL log2(p/control), including the own coordinate. Nonown corrections bounded +/-0.375 versus the closed V66 log-ratio; own allowed to change. All encoded values clipped +/-3, unexpressed query coordinates abstain. Candidate count emission calls the original V16 emitter with own=None so no second suppression is applied. V66 baseline uses its original own argument.
negative_controls: Mixture: cyclic active-target proportion residuals with recipient nonpanel norm; preserve genuine recipient own probability before reclosure. Dose: apply the own-factor change to a cyclic wrong target gene. Decoder constraints can alter exact norm matching; measure final profiles. No outcome-based shuffle choice.
selection: Same first-three distinct development cases/context, >=0.5% profile gain, worst study <=2% worse, beats its shuffled control. Lock before scoring new-model remaining cases. Every public cohort has been used in earlier experiments, including V75 confirmation: no blind claim.
confirmation: PDS requires >=2 distinct targets. Fixed PDS panels use ALL 4/4/6/8/8 unique cases/context (30 total); profile/DE primary summaries use only remaining 1/1/3/5/5 (15 total). This repairs V75 singleton-PDS infeasibility, without dropping the PDS gate. Two seeds 0/+620000; fresh V66 replays and raw-p audits; fixed broad >=30-cell profile/PDS/shuffle gates. Production requires primary/repeat profile/worst-study/PDS/shuffle and broad checks. All other failures/missing remain explicit.
